description: This file defines functions for interacting with loan draft-related API endpoints. It includes methods for creating, listing, retrieving, updating, checking readiness, submitting, deciding, and deleting loan drafts for the applicant portal. The functions use an API client to make HTTP requests to specific endpoints related to loan draft management, handling data serialization via the toJsonString helper.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Helper function to serialize a JavaScript value into a JSON string, using a fallback in case of error. Validates string inputs and attempts to stringify non-string values.

methods.name: createDraft
methods.description: Creates a new loan application draft for the authenticated user by sending data, section status, and current step to the backend.

methods.name: listDrafts
methods.description: Retrieves the list of existing loan drafts for the current user.

methods.name: getDraft
methods.description: Fetches a specific loan draft by its ID.

methods.name: patchDraftSection
methods.description: Updates a specific section of a loan draft with new data, status, and step information.

methods.name: checkDraftReadiness
methods.description: Checks if a draft is ready for submission based on required sections and documents.

methods.name: submitDraft
methods.description: Submits a draft for processing, optionally running decisioning workflows.

methods.name: decideDraft
methods.description: Runs risk scoring and decisioning algorithms on a draft.

methods.name: deleteDraft
methods.description: Deletes a draft if it has not been submitted.
